name: College Now (MDUSD and Diablo Valley College)
org: Mt. Diablo Unified School District and Diablo Valley College
city: Pleasant Hill, CA (at Diablo Valley College)
what_you_do: Spend your junior and senior years on a college campus. You take three high school classes taught by Mt. Diablo teachers. You take the rest of your classes at DVC and earn high school and college credit.
who_can_apply: Mt. Diablo Unified students who are interested and eligible. In 2026-2027 class capacity will be 60 juniors and 60 seniors. Talk to your high school counselor about the rules.
pay_detail: Cost is not stated on the College Now page. DVC says its dual enrollment classes are free.
deadline_text: Applications for 2026-2027 were due Thursday, Feb 12, 2026, with no late applications. The page says the application is held in the spring. The next dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Talk to your high school counselor. Then fill out the College Now student application on the program page. A recommendation form is also on the page. Go to the parent night if you can.
notes: The program started in fall 2016. The 2026 parent night was Wed, Feb 4, 2026. Staff phone on the page: 925-969-2512. The DVC page also lists a related program called Diamante Scholars for Mt. Diablo seniors.
